label: Aqara Hub M2 Zigbee 3.0 home hub
description: Aqara Hub M2 is a Zigbee 3.0 + BLE 5.0 hub with a built-in IR blaster that bridges Aqara sensors, switches and curtains to HomeKit, Alexa, Google Home and Aqara Home. It is dual-homed on the IP side: an RJ45 Ethernet port plus 2.4 GHz 802.11 b/g/n WiFi, so either can be used to reach the LAN; its Zigbee/BLE radios are device-side only and are not modelled.
